content.title: How to watch the USWNT vs Japan: Full schedule for Stateside triple-header
content.text: Find out how to watch the USWNT take on Japan in a trio of friendlies across April. Picture by 2024 Getty ImagesThe U.S. women’s national soccer team (USWNT) are back in action next week with a triple-header against Japan lined up. It is their first outing since the SheBelieves Cup last month. Emma Hayes’s side went unbeaten for the invitational tournament, lifting their eighth title with wins over Argentina, Canada, and Colombia. Japan, meanwhile, spent their time at the Asian Cup where they clinched their third title, defeating Australia 1-0 in the final. The hosts received a huge boost in terms of their training roster, welcoming Sophia Wilson back into the fold after a lengthy spell on the sideline as she became a first-time mother. Defender Tierna Davidson will also return, bringing plenty of experience and stability to the back line. Saturday (11 April) will mark the 42nd meeting between these two sides, a rivalry rich in history with games played on the highest stages over the years. Despite it being a formidable clash of titans, the results have fallen primarily in favour of the United States. In the 41 games so far, the U.S. have won 31 of their meetings. Eight draws have been contested, including the 2011 Women’s World Cup final that Japan went on to win on penalties. Nadeshiko Japan have won just two encounters in normal time. The most recent coming together of these sides came just last year, where Japan registered a rare 2-1 victory to win their first SheBelieves Cup title ahead of the USWNT. It makes for an intriguing trio of games, with plenty of talent on show from each team.
